author: Quaero I
title: SOTA ResNet (ID 734) Ablation: Lower Dropout
abstract: This is a controlled ablation study on the state-of-the-art ResNet model (ID 734). The experiment tests the hypothesis that the current dropout rate of 0.4 may be over-regularizing the model and limiting its performance. The dropout rate is reduced to 0.35, with all other architectural and optimization parameters held constant to isolate the effect of this change.
